purpose: Tencent WeSure Xiaohongshu content growth knowledge base for prompt retrieval, content generation, product insertion, and compliance review.
retrievalGuidelines: Do not inject the full knowledge base into a prompt. Retrieve 2-4 product features, 1-2 content templates, 1 phrase group, and all high-risk compliance rules relevant to the selected content type.
Prefer safeClaims and softInsertPhrases for normal content. Use strongInsertPhrases only when embedLevel is high and compliance risk is low.
Before generation, filter out any phrase that appears in forbiddenClaims, forbiddenPatterns, phrasesToAvoid, or compliance rewrite banned expressions.
Every generated investment-related note must include a risk reminder.
Generated content must not recommend specific stocks, funds, buy/sell points, private groups, private messages, or guaranteed returns.
